heard: Mir was nearly destroyed by its own cargo ship. Many believe that space docking is always a safe, automated routine, like when a cargo ship docked on April 8, 1997. But on June 25, 1997, a manual docking test went horribly wrong. Commander Vasily Tzibliev lost control of the heavy-progress cargo ship. The runaway vessel crashed directly into Mir's spectre module, damaging a solar panel. The violent collision punctured Mir's hull, causing a critical air leak. To save the station, the crew sealed off Spectre by cutting its power cables. This desperate cut left the station at half power, tumbling in complete darkness. This harrowing near miss proved that to survive a collision, Mir was nearly destroyed by its own cargo ship.
